description:
Autoscroll stays pinned to the bottom while tall diffs hydrate. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}}. Call "big patch" sends it the message "big patch", whose reply ends in a patch with a diff many viewports tall, and returns without waiting for the reply. The page already runs a sampler that the test installed before the page's own scripts; do not create, reset or replace the sampler, window.__sampledHosts or window.__emptyGaps (only read them, in step 4). It checks every ".patch-tool-diff-host" element once per animation frame from page load on: window.__sampledHosts is the Set of hosts it has seen, and window.__emptyGaps counts the samples where a host had neither an inline style.minHeight (its placeholder) nor a rendered diff (a "pre" in the shadowRoot of its "diffs-container"). "The gap" is the messages container's (".messages-container") scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) and the messages container to be visible.
2. Then four turns, for N = 1, 2, 3 and 4 in turn (spell out each turn's steps with its own N): call "big patch"; wait until document.querySelectorAll(".patch-tool").length is exactly N (allow 30s); wait until the number of "diffs-container" elements whose shadow root has content, [...document.querySelectorAll("diffs-container")].filter((el) => (el.shadowRoot?.innerHTML.length ?? 0) > 0).length, is exactly N (allow 30s); then wait until the gap is below 120 (allow 15s).
3. document.querySelectorAll(".scroll-to-bottom-button").length must be exactly 0: never scrolled away, so the button must not exist at all.
4. window.__sampledHosts.size must be at least 4, and window.__emptyGaps must be exactly 0.
